title: Wall-Closing Treatment Returned on Reconstruction Drywall and Insulation Removals
content:
A drywall or insulation removal on a Reconstruction deductive change order returns the wall-closing treatment priced with that scope, at the treatment rate times the change-order part of the removal.

**Treatment rate returned.** The rate comes from the company mitigation job that preceded the rebuild, as recorded on the contract:

- where that job is a Water Damage Mitigation job assessed category 3: the water job tier's antimicrobial rate per square foot;
- where it is a Fire & Smoke Mitigation job: the fire job tier's odor sealer rate per square foot;
- where it is a Mold Remediation job: the mold job tier's encapsulation rate per square foot;
- otherwise no treatment is returned.

## Points of judgement

| Removed line | Preceding company job | Treatment returned |
|---|---|---|
| drywall or insulation | water job, category 3 | antimicrobial rate times the change-order part |
| drywall or insulation | fire job | odor sealer rate times the change-order part |
| drywall or insulation | mold job | encapsulation rate times the change-order part |
| drywall or insulation | water job of category 1 or 2, or none | none |
| any other scope | any | none |

The treatment is figured on the change-order part only; the contract part of a removal returns no treatment.

**Example (hypothetical rate).** A drywall removal whose change-order part is 150 square feet, after a mold job whose tier's encapsulation rate is assumed at $0.60 per square foot, returns $90.00 of treatment.
